scores.evidence: The objectives did not change, and q2, q3 (o1) and q6 (o2) keep their objectiveId and Bloom level after the option edits. Every objective still has 2 or more items, including apply-level or higher ones, and e1 and e3 remain transfer items. As before, o1 is a create objective, but only pr-checklist checks it at that level.

hook-b1 sets a concrete problem in 3 sentences (「毎回同じ手順をClaude Codeに貼り付けていませんか」), and the ungraded hook-q leads into 7-1. But hook-q mostly asks learners to recall lesson 6 (its explanation says 「（第6回）」), and the second problem in hook-b1, research output flooding the conversation, gets no prediction.

Re-scored because the courseId change places the lesson in a new course sequence. The new "courseId": "claude-code" matches content/courses/claude-code/course.json ("id": "claude-code"). There, the cc-07 entry sits in module m3 「プロジェクトに合わせて育てる」 between cc-06-claude-md (whose next is cc-07-skills-subagents) and cc-08-hooks-mcp (next.lessonId). The course entry's title 「第7回｜手順はスキルに、調べものはサブエージェントに」 and estMinutes 18 match the lesson. The lesson's prerequisite 「第6回｜CLAUDE.mdで前提を伝える」 and summary-next's 「第8回｜フックで守らせ、MCPでつなぐ」 match the published cc-06 and cc-08 titles exactly. The 「（第6回）」 pointers in hook-q and s1, and 「（第8回で扱います）」 in s4-table, also fit the course order. The glossary and the s1-defs/s3-defs terms have not changed.

measure.mjs still reports 「prose 2167 (budget 1,200–2,400) · est 17.8 min (must be ≤ 20; estMinutes 18)」, and lint --strict gives 0 errors and 0 warnings. The unexplained `>-` notation in ex-description (「長い説明文は、`>-` のあとで改行し、字下げして続けます。」) has not changed and still adds load to 7-2.

s2-skill still models 「何をするか」 and 「いつ使うか」 in its description, and its highlight [2–7] now covers exactly the name and the 4 description lines. ex-slash now names the action (「`/commit-message` と入力します。」), and ex-description says where the file goes (「できたフォルダに、エディターで `SKILL.md` を作ります。」). The subagent half of the practice is still not demonstrated before practice.

q3 d is one line, 「手順：`npm test` を実行する／失敗を一覧にする／原因を調べる」, and keeps its feedback. q2 can still be answered by recalling the key that s2-invoke names just before it. The s4-table list is directly before q6, and its wording overlaps q6's options: 「何度も貼っているなら、**スキル**にします」 vs b 「毎週チャットに貼っている」, and 「Claudeが2回まちがえたら」 vs a 「Claudeが2回まちがえた」. So q6 (bloom evaluate) still leans on matching words.

The rewritten q3 d still targets the misconception that the steps belong in the description, and its feedback still fits (「手順は本文に書く内容です。説明文には、何をするスキルで、いつ使うのかを書きます。」). The other distractors and their feedback did not change.

s4-table is a bullet list. Every item follows the same pattern of trigger, then tool in bold, then how it loads: 「同じ依頼文や手順書を何度も貼っているなら、**スキル**にします。説明文は毎回、本文は使うときに読み込まれます」. Because each item starts with the trigger, the list signals the section title 「足すのは「きっかけ」が来てから」, and it fits mobile. s1-diagram (5 nodes) and s3-diagram are unchanged, and the 「本文は読み込まない」 branch is still not drawn.

pr-model's highlight [3–6] marks the description and 「disable-model-invocation: true」, which pr-model-lead explains. The task, the expect on every step, pr-prompt and pr-checklist did not change. pr-write still has a single hint (「7-2の `commit-message` を手本に」) before the full model answer.

summary-points comes after the exam. summary-next keeps the lesson-specific reflection (「スキルにしたい手順と、サブエージェントに任せたい調べものを1つずつ」) and names the next lesson by its exact title, 「第8回｜フックで守らせ、MCPでつなぐ」. It is followed by 6 flashcards and askTutor suggestions.

s4-table cites cc-features-overview, and each claim matches the audit's quotes from that page. 「Claudeが2回まちがえたら、**CLAUDE.md**に書きます」 matches "Claude gets a convention or command wrong twice | Add it to CLAUDE.md". 「説明文は毎回、本文は使うときに読み込まれます」 matches "Descriptions at start, full content when used". 「見返さない調べものの出力が会話にあふれるなら、**サブエージェント**に任せます」 matches "A side task floods your conversation with output you won't reference again | Route it through a subagent". The `>-` factual doubt has not changed.

The s4-table items use です・ます and stay warm and directive (「〜なら、**スキル**にします。」), and lint finds no banned phrases or long sentences. The tool names match the glossary (スキル, サブエージェント, フック, CLAUDE.md). Carried issue: the s1-diagram nodes say 「読む」 while its caption and alt say 「読み込まれる」. The ja-editor owns the wording.
The jp locale is complete. s4-table is a semantic bullet list of 4 self-contained sentences. The s3-diagram alt matches what the diagram shows, and the s2-legacy link text is descriptive.
